answer: Each identity derives a 4 GB dataset from its public key with Argon2id and keeps it on local NVMe. Every epoch a beacon draws 32 random chunk indices, and the agent must return Merkle openings within 400 ms, so remote fetching fails when queries wander across the sable address space. A miss burns 20 tokens from a 100 token bond, and three straight misses revoke payouts. Ten thousand clones need 40 TB of fast disk, about $4,000 of drives plus 55 hours of hashing and $1,000 monthly hosting. The swarm becomes a nebula of dust where every grain still demands its own physical mass.
